method: Current actual game at 20 Hz; current honey-maxing completion prefix; six held-out seeds 1401-1406. Capacity grants buy all available land and production upgrades, 5 min settle + 15 min measure. Mature forks freeze earned upgrades and staffing, 5 min settle + 10 min measure. Normal-game branches use seeds 1501-1503. Price-only paybacks are calculated at observed mean physical sales, with per-100 payout rounding excluded from marginal formula. No production files changed.

capacity.method: 20 Hz actual game economy; one-second decisions; actual offers and charges; real research, letters and boarding; home/hollow/return; no grants, jumps or injected progress. Finale begins at finish; cinematic duration excluded. Seed resets each visit. Browser timers/rendering disabled.
